designSummary: Overview of reviews with a citation matrix; no new meta-analysis unless overlap within an outcome can be removed.
sampleSize: The unit is the review: about 15 reviews are expected from 2017. Precision comes from the underlying primary studies, so for each outcome the overview reports the number of unique primary studies and participants after removing overlap; if fewer than five unique controlled studies report an outcome, no pooled estimate is reported.
primaryAnalysis: Narrative synthesis per outcome led by the highest-quality, most recent, least overlapping review, with the corrected covered area and GRADE certainty for each outcome.
secondaryAnalysis: Re-pooling of unique controlled studies for consultation rate only if at least five exist after removing duplicates; subgroup findings for people with complex needs extracted narratively.
missingData: Reviews not reporting their included studies are listed and excluded from the citation matrix; no author contact.
multiplicity: Descriptive outcomes graded separately; no significance testing across outcomes.
software: Spreadsheet citation matrix; R for the corrected covered area and any re-pooling.
overfittingGuards: Outcome list fixed before the search
Rule for choosing the lead review per outcome fixed in advance
No re-pooling below five unique controlled studies
summary: About 15 reviews; precision reported as unique primary studies per outcome after removing overlap.
